name: provtrace-ts
description: Provenance Tracer (ProvTrace) - W3C PROV process mining prototype for software development

scripts.policy:test: opa check --strict --schema policies/schema.json policies/ && opa test policies/ -v
scripts.policy:build: opa check --strict --schema policies/schema.json policies/ && opa build -t wasm -e provtrace/governance/anomalies -e provtrace/governance/rules -e provtrace/governance/findings -o policies/bundle.tar.gz policies/prov.rego policies/governance.rego && tar -m -xzf policies/bundle.tar.gz -C policies /policy.wasm && rm -f policies/bundle.tar.gz
